Volkswagen Tiguan 2 (AD) (2016-2023)

Updated 24 November 2026

Yes: VAG Scope supports the Volkswagen Tiguan 2 (AD) (2016-2023, MQB platform) over 11-bit CAN UDS with an open Bluetooth ELM327 adapter, 100% offline with no subscription. Full control-unit scans, mileage and VIN checks, live data, coding and adaptations work offline.

Technical overview

ItemDetail
Brand & modelVolkswagen Tiguan 2 (AD)
Model years2016-2023
PlatformMQB
Protocol11-bit CAN UDS
Verification statusProtocol supported (testers welcome)
SFD write protectionNo SFD write lock (offline reading and coding supported)
Recommended adapterOpen Bluetooth ELM327 (vLinker MC+ or vGate iCar Pro 2S; Classic or BLE on Android, BLE on iPhone)

Generation notes

MQB 11-bit UDS SUV with full multi-unit scanning, mileage/VIN checks, live data, adaptations and coding offline with an open ELM327 adapter.

What works on this generation

  • Pre-purchase health check: fault codes, cross-module mileage comparison and VIN check in one signed PDF report.
  • Full control-unit scan, advanced identification and fault clearing with automatic backup and confirmation.
  • Searchable live data (measuring blocks / UDS DIDs), 60-second charts, CSV logging and Android Auto dashboards.
  • Performance Hub: 0-500 km/h timing (100 Hz OBD + phone IMU fusion), virtual dyno and signed PNG/PDF proof cards without GPS permission.
  • Coding, long coding, gateway installation list, adaptations, basic settings, output tests and service reset with automatic backup and read-back.
